    col_panels = [(col_bounds[i] + 1, col_bounds[i + 1]) for i in range(len(col_bounds) - 1)]

        for j in range(0, len(col_panels) - 1, 2):
            c0, c1 = col_panels[j]
            d0, d1 = col_panels[j + 1]
            left = [(r, c, g[r][c]) for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1) if g[r][c] != 0]

                for r, c, color in left:

                for r, c, color in right:

from hermes_tools import write_file, terminal
p='/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-hermes-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-2/play/users/u024/system/state/workspace/programs/task-71e65a5f.py'
s='''def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    div = next(v for v in range(1, 10) if any(all(row[c] == v for row in g) for c in range(w)))
    row_cuts = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == div for v in g[r])]
    col_cuts = [c for c in range(w) if all(g[r][c] == div for r in range(h))]
    rb = [-1] + row_cuts + [h]
    cb = [-1] + col_cuts + [w]
    rows = [(rb[i] + 1, rb[i + 1]) for i in range(len(rb) - 1)]
    cols = [(cb[i] + 1, cb[i + 1]) for i in range(len(cb) - 1)]
    def cells(band, panel):
        r0, r1 = rows[band]; c0, c1 = cols[panel]
        return {(r-r0, c-c0, g[r][c]) for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1) if g[r][c] != 0}
    pairs=set()
    for b in range(len(rows)):
        for p in range(len(cols)-1):
            a,z=cells(b,p),cells(b,p+1)
            if a and z and cols[p][1]-cols[p][0] == cols[p+1][1]-cols[p+1][0]:
                width=cols[p][1]-cols[p][0]
                if {(rr,width-1-cc,color) for rr,cc,color in a} == z: pairs.add((p,p+1))
    for p,q in pairs:
        width=cols[p][1]-cols[p][0]
        for b,(r0,r1) in enumerate(rows):
            a,z=cells(b,p),cells(b,q)
            if a and not z:
                d0=cols[q][0]
                for rr,cc,color in a: g[r0+rr][d0+width-1-cc]=color
            elif z and not a:
                c0=cols[p][0]
                for rr,cc,color in z: g[r0+rr][c0+width-1-cc]=color
    return g
'''
